decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">Notwithstanding the Ecological Assessment dated February
2025, prior to the completion of the development at least 1 x 1B Schwegler Bird
Nest Box shall be installed on a tree located within the site or on the
dwellinghouse. The Bird Nest Box should be located at least 5 metres up from
the ground level and should face north to east. The Bird Nest Box shall
thereafter be retained.</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height:normal">Flood Risk Assessment; Reasonable Exception Statement;&nbsp; Ecology Report; PR24-095a;&nbsp;PR24-095b;&nbsp;PR24-095c;&nbsp;PR24-095d; PR24-095e;&nbsp;PR24-095f;&nbsp;</span>PR24-095g;&nbsp;1588-006-PL-FDS-01;&nbsp;1588-006-PL-DP-01.
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch, Single storey and first floor rear extension, Alterations to rear garden levels (Demolition of ground floor rear bay window)
